name: pi-remote
description: Local terminal client for persistent, unmodified remote Pi RPC processes

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -b && npm run build:web
scripts.check: tsc -b && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:mobile: npm run build && node --import tsx test/smoke/mobile-browser.ts
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
